datasets.name: claims
datasets.description: One row per claim - the grain fct_claims is built at.

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

metrics.name: claim_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN claims.claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Total number of claims processed by the platform.

metrics.name: total_claimed_amount
metrics.description: Sum of all claimed dollar amounts across claims.

metrics.name: flagged_claim_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN claim__is_flagged = true THEN CASE WHEN claims.claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END)

metrics.description: Number of claims flagged by the reconciliation agent for amount/severity mismatch.

metrics.name: flagged_claim_rate

dialects.expression: (SUM(CASE WHEN claim__is_flagged = true THEN CASE WHEN claims.claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END)) / (SUM(CASE WHEN claims.claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))

metrics.description: Share of all claims flagged for review - the single number claims ops watches daily.

metrics.name: avg_cv_confidence
metrics.description: Mean confidence of the damage-severity classifier's predictions - a model-health signal.
